pinterest.title: AI Systems Checklist: What to Test, Gate, and Budget For
pinterest.description: A practical checklist for teams evaluating new AI tools: test for repeatability, add review where it matters, and budget for infrastructure and availability. Use this saveable guide to decide what to adopt now and what to watch.

snippet.title: Friday watchlist: the AI systems worth testing, gating and budgeting for
snippet.description: Pick one system change to test: either a customizable open-weight model for a narrow task, or an AI-assisted review step for one existing approval.
